_doc: PRIOR ART: scripts/maintenance/reap-prs.mjs — classifies mergeability, not risk. This file holds the risk tiers for PRs. HOLD = a human merges (Derek). AUTO = auto-merge.yml merges when green. Edit the globs here, not the script. Globs are minimatch-style against the repo-relative path; diffPatterns are regexes tested against ADDED lines only.

hold.reason: money: payments, spend controls, crons and their handlers
page-image storage keys (the #3362 class: a book-independent key shares images between books and nothing fails loudly)
public copy Derek has not seen
public copy Derek has not seen: interface strings in a language other than English
hold._doc: #6403. An added entry keyed by a non-English site locale (`nl: {`, `zh: '…'`, `es: (n) =>`) is copy a reader of that language will see: a new language block in a dictionary, or a component's inline per-locale map. #6384 added ~1,000 lines of Dutch and Chinese per language and was classed AUTO. Keep the locale list in step with PREFIXED_LOCALES (src/lib/locale-path.ts). It does not see an edit to one string inside an existing block.

hold.reason: doctrine or enforcement (CLAUDE.md, hooks, workflows, commands)
data deletion or migration in the diff

_diffIgnoreDoc: diffPatterns fire only on added lines that can execute. Lines in these files are prose, fixtures or results, never run against data; comment-only lines are skipped too. The path globs above are NOT affected: a file under scripts/migrations/ still holds whatever it contains. src/generated/** is generated data (ustc-year-counts.json keys its counts by language code): regenerating it neither runs nor publishes anything, and the blog copy there still holds by its path glob.
